title: WeCut recipe (format 1)
description: The shape of an edit without its content: sections fed by roles, text slots, caption and music style, effects, picture slots such as a logo. A section may list its shots one by one (exact cut lengths, like the slots of a CapCut template; `wecut clone` writes these) or describe them loosely so they stretch to any footage. `wecut recipe apply` turns a recipe plus new clips, words, pictures and music into a project. Section text times are seconds from the start of the section; recipe-level text times are seconds of the whole video.

about.description: What the recipe makes and when to use it.

maxDuration.description: Longest the video may be; the last section fills up to it.

role.description: Name the input clips use to feed this section, e.g. hook, body. A section without clips borrows the start of the next section's footage.

duration.description: Seconds; 0 or absent = whatever is left.

shot.description: Cut long clips into shots of about this length (jump cuts); images last this long. Absent = keep clips whole.

zoom.description: Punch in on every other shot (cover only).

motion.description: Images: Ken Burns move; alternate cycles in, left, out, right.

mute.description: Silence the footage's own sound in this section, so only the music plays.

join.description: Between shots inside the section. Absent = hard cut.

shots.description: Exact cuts, one media slot each. Replaces duration, shot, zoom and join. Clips fill them one per slot (fill=each) or one after another (fill=sequence).

audio.description: next: this section's footage is silent and the next section's sound starts under it, carrying on into that footage (a J-cut: the talk begins over B-roll and a headline card).

texts.description: Slots timed against the whole video, e.g. a call to action with fromEnd.

captions.description: Caption style. Captions appear when a transcript is passed at apply time.

music.description: The soundtrack. src is the default track (like the song in a CapCut template); music passed at apply time replaces it, and "none" drops it.

src.description: Workspace audio file, or a video whose sound is used (for example the reference video). A song taken from someone else's video may be muted by the platform when you upload.

from.description: Start point in the track, e.g. the beat drop.

at.description: Start time on the output timeline.

duration.description: Playback length on the output timeline.

bpm.description: Tempo of the original, for choosing music.

note.description: Advice shown when no music is passed.

on.description: cuts = every shot change, sections = every section change, time = at.

every.description: Only every Nth cut or section change.

at.description: For on=time: seconds; negative = before the end.

overlays.description: Picture slots laid over the video, such as a logo. The picture is passed at apply time as overlays.<slot>.

slot.description: Name the picture is passed under, e.g. logo.

src.description: Default picture in the workspace, used when none is passed.

fromEnd.description: Show only for the last this-many seconds.

source.description: Where a cloned recipe came from. Information only.

used.description: Seconds of the original that were cloned (a platform outro is left out).

box.description: card: one box behind the whole block, like a news headline card.

dur.description: Seconds on screen, including the overlap of a join into the next shot.

zoomTo.description: The zoom glides from zoom to this over the shot.

continue.description: Carry on the clip of the shot before (its next seconds) instead of taking the next clip, like a punch-in on one take.

join.description: Into the next shot of this section.

ref.description: Where this shot sits in the source video, in seconds (clone).

slot.description: Name the words are passed under at apply time (texts.<slot>).

text.description: Default or example words, used when none are passed.

fromEnd.description: Start this many seconds before the end of its section (or video) and run to the end.

maxWidth.description: Wrap lines at this fraction of the canvas width.

lineHeight.description: Exact line spacing (times the size); the background becomes a card sized to the text.

padding.description: Card padding in px at 1080: [all], [x, y] or [top, right, bottom, left].

emphasis.description: Words of the default text to colour, used only with the default text.

emphasisColor.description: Colour for the words passed as emphasis.
